annotations.text:
One question, four answers: how much colour survives.

Same screens, same values lifted from the shipped app — only palette, starfield tint and accent stance change. Type stays Georgia + Abhaya Libre in all four so the comparison is about colour, not typefaces.

The starfields are CSS-drawable (positioned dots + two broad glows), not the holding page's stock video.

The domain's holding page is a GoDaddy builder template and its background is GoDaddy stock video — not reusable here. These starfields are ours: a few KB, animate in canvas/CSS, work offline, tint to any palette.
